brief:
Israeli occupation forces destroyed water infrastructure in the Palestinian villages of Atouf and Ras al-Ahmar, Shehab Wire reported. The demolition of water lines left residents in both communities without access to piped water supplies, forcing them to seek alternative sources for drinking and household use.

The destruction compounds existing water scarcity in the region, where Palestinian civilians already face severe shortages. Infrastructure damage in occupied areas has become recurring, with water systems repeatedly targeted or dismantled. Atouf and Ras al-Ahmar join other communities across the territory experiencing disruptions to essential services amid the broader conflict.
title: Israeli forces destroy water lines in Atouf and Ras al-Ahmar
